parties.petitioner: The Cosmos Co Operative Bank Ltd

summary: Dispute over priority of mortgage charge; equitable mortgage by deposit of title deeds under Transfer of Property Act, 1882 s.58(f); Central Bank's 1989 mortgage held prior to Cosmos Bank's 1998 claim; lack of valid title deeds at loan sanctioning fatal to later mortgage; DRAT finding on priority upheld; High Court affirmed; appeal dismissed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned judgment of High Court upheld.
